name: When the summons outlasted its caller

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

summary: Later entries darken the triumph. Velinde says the packs grew even when she no longer summoned them; one group sent to range through the forest never returned. She worried that the leaders she had trusted were beyond her control, gathered what worgen she could, and ordered them to remain at the shrine. Her journal then records a search through Darnassus and Darkshore for knowledge, and a rumor that the wizard Arugal had also summoned worgen. It gives her reason to seek him, but does not show that meeting or settle what happened to every pack.
